title: Zombies on Your Lawn
lyrics:
[00:08.96]Sunflower!
[00:18.34]One, two, three!
[00:20.08]There's a zombie on your lawn
[00:24.63]There's a zombie on your lawn
[00:29.18]There's a zombie on your lawn
[00:33.46]We don't want zombies on our lawn
[00:38.04]I know your type, tall, dark, and dead
[00:41.05]You want to bite all the petals off of my head
[00:44.07]And then eat the brains of the one who planted me here
[00:48.33]I'm just a sunflower, but see me power an entire infantry
[00:52.94]You like the taste of brains, we don't like zombies
[00:58.61]I used to play football (Football)
[01:03.22]Road cones protect my head (Cone on his head)
[01:07.73]I have a screen door shield (Door shield)
[01:12.75]We are the undead
[01:14.89]There's a zombie on your lawn
[01:19.48]There's a zombie on your lawn
[01:24.06]There's a zombie on your lawn
[01:28.31]We don't want zombies on our lawn
[01:32.91]Maybe, it's time to reevaluate
[01:35.99]I know you have a lot of food on your plate
[01:38.95]Brains are quite rich in cholesterol
[01:43.23]You're dead, so it doesn't matter
[01:45.55]Instead, we'll use this solar power to make a lawn defense at any hour
[01:53.49]I like your tricycle (Tricycle)
[01:57.95]There's butter on my head (On his head)
[02:02.63]I'm gonna eat your brains (Oh, no, no, no)
[02:07.76]We are the undead
[02:09.81]There's a zombie on your lawn
[02:14.34]There's a zombie on your lawn
[02:18.90]There's a zombie on your lawn
[02:23.22]We don't want zombies on our lawn
